title: cnicus × tartaricus
intro: Cnicus × tartaricus, commonly known as the hybrid cinquefoil, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and has been used to treat various conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Cnicus × tartaricus include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
